name: prospectar
description: Read a B2B commercial team's catalog and funnel stages on Prospectar.

interface.longDescription: Prospectar connects your agent to the catalog and commercial funnel of a B2B sales team on Prospectar. Read the active offerings, services and products with their category, written label, fixed amount in centavos when applicable, meeting duration and visibility, and read the ordered stages of the funnel without exposing customer contacts or conversations. All tools are read-only.
capabilities: List active offerings, services and products in the company catalog
Read written labels, meeting durations and visibility per catalog item
List the ordered stages of the B2B sales funnel
defaultPrompt: List the services and products in my Prospectar catalog.
Which items in my Prospectar catalog are currently visible?
What are the stages of my sales funnel on Prospectar?
